import html # Predefined HTML template with a placeholder for user content. html_template = """ Visitor Page

Welcome!

{user_content}

""" def create_html_response(visitor_content: str) -> str: """ Construct an HTML page embedding the user-provided content safely. Parameters ---------- visitor_content : str Content supplied by the user that will be inserted into the HTML page. Returns ------- str The complete HTML document with the escaped user content. """ # Escape any special HTML characters to prevent XSS or injection attacks. safe_content = html.escape(visitor_content, quote=True) # Fill the template with the safely escaped content. return html_template.format(user_content=safe_content)
